description: Dated events from the tech calendar on jsplinter.nl: release days, support changes and end-of-life dates for the technology on Jonas's timeline (whole product lines: every PHP, Python, Ubuntu LTS, Laravel and Windows version), plus his own milestones (started or stopped using something) and blog posts. Each event has a date (YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD), kind, title, the technology, its page, a source for world dates, and how far from today. Use around for "what just happened / what is next"; otherwise filter by words, kind and period (oldest first). Page: https://jsplinter.nl/calendar/ ; JSON: https://jsplinter.nl/myapi/calendar.php

around.description: Optional: return the N latest past and N next upcoming events (other filters except kind are ignored).

from.description: Optional earliest date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, or "today".

kind.description: Optional: release, support (a support phase ends), eol (end of life), mine (Jonas started/stopped using it) or post (blog post).

query.description: Optional words that must all appear in the title, technology or topic, e.g. "php end of life" or "windows 11". Max 120 characters.

to.description: Optional latest date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, or "today".

name: calendar
title: Tech calendar
